concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-development-resources-pci-dss-compliance-guide-merchant-levels]] — 2020-modified Adyen PCI merchant-level and validation table, scoped by annual transactions per acquiring region and scheme, with assessor, AoC/RoC handling, and conditional scan guidance (collected 2026-09-15).
warnings: The threshold page was last modified 2020-02-24 and links a PCI DSS v3.2.1 RoC template; do not substitute it for current PCI SSC, acquirer, or scheme requirements.
The table uses adjacent 'between' bands without clarifying exact shared endpoint treatment; this source does not establish a merchant's assigned level or completed compliance.
